tools.name: Number Base Converter
tools.primary_functionality: Convert exact signed integers between bases 2–36 in one interface, with binary/octal/decimal/hex presets.
tools.dependencies_and_browser_apis: Native BigInt and strings; existing pure inline adapter, DOM, clipboard and Blob download patterns; no new package.
tools.provisional_input_output_limits: 4,096 input digits plus optional sign; base 2–36; output at most 32,768 digits. Reject before allocating an oversized result. ASCII digits only; leading/trailing whitespace explicitly trimmed.
tools.security_gate: Normal bounded-input review: preflight digit count/alphabet/base; manual digit accumulation into BigInt for arbitrary bases; never route large integers through Number; text-only output, no persistence/network.
tools.important_tests: 0, -0, negative values, leading zeros, all bases, invalid digit/base, empty input, 4,096/4,097 boundary; independent integer vectors beyond 2^53; A→B→A; exact output cap; reset/copy/export/no transport.
tools.duplicate_check: Base64 converts UTF-8 bytes to an alphabet encoding; this converts mathematical integers. File Size Converter converts physical byte quantities. Base modes stay combined as one utility.
tools.known_limitations: Integers only, no fractions/scientific notation, two’s-complement width or binary-file editing. Exact arithmetic does not make unlimited-size input safe.
tools.task23_origin_status: UNREGISTERED PROPOSAL — not approved, implemented or tested

tools.name: Unit Converter
tools.primary_functionality: Convert a reviewed fixed set of length, mass, area, volume and temperature units; restrict conversion to one dimension and show the selected factor/formula.
tools.dependencies_and_browser_apis: Native Number arithmetic, fixed local unit table, DOM/clipboard/Blob. No rates service or new library.
tools.provisional_input_output_limits: One complete decimal value at most 64 UTF-16 units; magnitude at most 10^12; reject nonfinite results or magnitude above 10^18. Display at most 12 significant digits and approximation indicator. Report at most 8 KiB.
tools.security_gate: Review factors against a primary standards source, including squared/cubed factors, affine temperature offsets and absolute-zero policy; reject ambiguous units (explicit US/Imperial labels). No arbitrary expressions/eval.
tools.important_tests: Known exact factors and inverse round trips with specified tolerance; 0 °C→32 °F/273.15 K; incompatible dimensions, ambiguous labels, negative lengths/mass, absolute-zero boundary, tiny/large/nonfinite/invalid values; accessible select/input/reset.
tools.duplicate_check: File Size Converter retains bytes/SI/IEC. Duration Calculator retains elapsed time. Percentage, VAT and finance tools calculate other relationships; no separate page per unit pair.
tools.known_limitations: Curated units, not every scientific quantity; floating-point rounding, no calibration/legal-metrology guarantee. Exclude bytes, time, currency, medical dosing and live rates.
tools.task23_origin_status: UNREGISTERED PROPOSAL — not approved, implemented or tested

tools.name: Duration Calculator
tools.primary_functionality: Add/subtract elapsed durations and normalize totals; signed HH:MM:SS[.mmm] lines with an explicit sign, plus decimal-free hour/minute/second breakdown. Compare exactly two durations by their exact signed millisecond totals.
tools.dependencies_and_browser_apis: Native BigInt integer milliseconds and string parsing; DOM/clipboard/Blob. No Date/timezone dependency.
tools.provisional_input_output_limits: At most 100 lines, 64 UTF-16 units per line, hours at most 999,999 per line; minutes/seconds 00–59, optional 1–3 fractional-second digits. Total/result report at most 64 KiB.
tools.security_gate: Strict grammar/line/hour limits and exact integer arithmetic; reject rather than normalize malformed 01:90:00; explain signed total and zero normalization. No timer/audio/notifications/storage.
tools.important_tests: Carry/borrow across minute/hour, fractional milliseconds, negative totals and -0, 100/101 lines, invalid fields, max sum exactness, add/subtract inverse; no DST dependence; keyboard/edit invalidates stale output.
tools.duplicate_check: Countdown/Pomodoro run real-time deadlines; Date Difference/Age/Working Days calculate calendar dates. Agenda Generator sums meeting items; this accepts arbitrary signed elapsed durations.
tools.known_limitations: Elapsed arithmetic only: no calendar months, local wall-clock times, time zones, payroll rules or running alarm. Locale decimal commas unsupported initially.

tools.name: URL Inspector & Query Builder
tools.primary_functionality: Show URL components and edit an ordered list of duplicate-preserving query name/value pairs; rebuild and copy a normalized HTTP(S) URL without visiting it. Explicit Inspect/Build action; no automatic URL visits. Native URL computation is covered by dedicated Node-native and real-browser tests, while generic inline run validates/prepares bounded text/options.
tools.dependencies_and_browser_apis: Native URL, URLSearchParams, TextEncoder, DOM/clipboard/Blob; no parser package, fetch, DNS or navigation.
tools.provisional_input_output_limits: Input at most 8,192 UTF-8 bytes; at most 100 query pairs; each pair field at most 2,048 UTF-16 units; combined rebuilt URL at most 16,384 UTF-8 bytes and report at most 32 KiB.
tools.security_gate: Reject non-HTTP(S), credentials and control characters before parsing; output as plain text, never an active href. Query secrets stay in memory. Explicitly disclose form-space/plus rules, IDN normalization and signed-URL changes; no URL safety claim.
tools.important_tests: Duplicate/empty parameters, order, + vs %2B vs %20, reserved characters, Unicode/IDN, fragments, default ports, malformed URL/control/credential/scheme denial, all byte/pair caps; spy for zero fetch/navigation/storage; reset/copy failure.
tools.duplicate_check: URL Encoder/Decoder exposes encodeURI/encodeURIComponent only and explicitly does not parse queries. This tool edits structure and repeated pairs; encoding/decoding directions remain one utility.
tools.known_limitations: WHATWG normalization may change byte representation or invalidate signatures. No reachability, phishing, registrable-domain or DNS validation; HTTP(S) only.

tools.name: List Comparison & Set Operations
tools.primary_functionality: Compare two line lists: union, intersection, A minus B, B minus A and symmetric difference. Preserve stable first-seen values and show duplicate/membership counts.
tools.dependencies_and_browser_apis: Native Set/Map and strings; structured/two-input inline adapter, DOM/clipboard/Blob. No regex or external dataset.
tools.provisional_input_output_limits: 50,000 UTF-16 units and 10,000 lines per input; one record at most 2,000 units; total output at most 100,000 units/400 KiB UTF-8. Bounded count summary.
tools.security_gate: Specify empty-line policy and comparison-only trim/case/NFC options; default exact matching, preserve first original spelling, use Map/Set (not unsafe object keys). Bound output before joining; text-only/no storage.
tools.important_tests: Every set operation with independent mathematical vectors; duplicate multiplicity, empty input/blank lines, CRLF, __proto__/constructor, accents/emoji, normalization and case options, stable ordering, limits, error invalidation and copy/export.
tools.duplicate_check: Text Difference Checker compares ordered sequences/line edits; Duplicate Line Remover deduplicates one list. This answers cross-list membership without a quadratic diff.
tools.known_limitations: Set membership rather than multiset subtraction or fuzzy matching. Native lowercase is not full locale case folding; matching options can intentionally merge values.

tools.name: Color Contrast Checker
tools.primary_functionality: Compare two opaque sRGB colours, calculate WCAG contrast and show AA/AAA normal/large-text labels with a fixed labelled text preview. Distinguish non-text 3:1 (SC 1.4.11) from AA large text 3:1, AA normal/AAA large 4.5:1 and AAA normal 7:1; explain context/exemptions.
tools.dependencies_and_browser_apis: Native numeric arithmetic and controlled DOM styles; editable hex/RGB fields and optional input type=color, clipboard/Blob. No image decoder, stylesheet parser or external library.
tools.provisional_input_output_limits: Two strict #RRGGBB values or three integer channels 0–255 per colour; at most 32 UTF-16 units per colour field. Report at most 4 KiB.
tools.security_gate: Allowlist colour grammar only; assign validated colour values to fixed preview properties, never accept arbitrary CSS/HTML. Compare unrounded ratios to thresholds; expose results in text, not colour alone.
tools.important_tests: Black/white 21:1, identical 1:1, channel endpoints, known independent luminance vectors, values just below/at/above 3/4.5/7 thresholds without rounding to pass, invalid alpha/CSS/HTML strings; complete keyboard workflow, labels and reset.
tools.duplicate_check: Image Color Picker samples one image pixel; it does not evaluate foreground/background pairs. CSS Gradient Generator produces CSS artwork and is not an accessibility evaluation.
tools.known_limitations: Opaque sRGB colours only; no alpha compositing, image backgrounds, APCA, site crawling or whole-page WCAG certification. Large-text applicability must be explained by the user’s context.
